raw_html: [[Armor Mastery|Quality Armor Mastery +2]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Armor Mastery|Quality Armor Mastery +2]]:''' Passive: +2 [[Quality bonus]] to the [[Maximum dexterity bonus|Max Dex Bonus]] of your equipped [[Light armor|light]], [[Medium armor|medium]], or [[heavy armor]]. This benefit does not apply to the [[Maximum dexterity bonus|Max Dex Bonus]] of a [[Tower Shield]].
